reason: Register_reuse is a small, source-grounded schedule change: each loaded operand is used by its first FMOPA sooner, with the same four ZA tiles, live Z registers, and K order. It is unmeasured, but it has a narrow correctness surface. Next are distinct scheduling and prefetch hypotheses; prefetch has added address and cache risk. Store regrouping and direct ZA stores could reduce output-transfer work, but exact instruction legality and scheduling benefits remain unverified. Packing and traversal proposals change more lifetimes, addresses, or timed work; the 64 KiB A-panel cache-blocking idea also overlaps the existing pack/consume structure and needs broader traversal changes. Cache-conflict padding has the least support: no conflict evidence is supplied, and it adds scratch traffic. Prior timing outcomes are noisy context only and do not establish causes.
